en.name: Xuncha
en.ability: Each night*, choose two good characters (different from the previous night): if they are both alive, they can't die tonight.

zh.name: 巡察
zh.ability: 每个夜晚*，你要选择两个善良角色（与上个夜晚不同）：如果他们都存活，他们当晚不会死亡。
